en: Hi and welcome to this course about Claude
Code. My name is Maximilian Schwarzmüller
and in this course I'll teach you the
efficient usage of Claude Code. Of course,
all the basics but also the more advanced
features. And I'll do that by building a
complete example project with help of Claude
Code so that it's not just the boring theory
but instead a real project where you see all
of Claude Code's features in action.
And therefore, let's not waste any time.
Let's dive right in and let's get started
